title: Supreme Court rejects plea to remove video of Italian politician’s ‘Vote Chor’ slogan at Bharat Summit 2026
points: Supreme Court rejected the plea to remove the 'Vote Chor' video from Bharat Summit 2026.
The Bench dismissed the petition filed against the Italian politician's slogan video.
Petitioner's counsel asked authorities to treat the matter as a formal representation.

title: For the second time this year, Guindy Children’s Park closed as birds die of suspected flu
points: Guindy Children’s Park was closed for the second time this year due to bird deaths.
The deaths are suspected to be caused by the flu.
Officials stated the closure is a precautionary measure.

title: Andhra Pradesh tenant farmers’ body seeks restoration of free crop insurance
points: Andhra Pradesh tenant farmers' body is demanding the restoration of free crop insurance.
Only 28.88 lakh out of 1.25 crore e-crop acres have insurance coverage.
The data was shared by association leader P. Jamal Mallaiah.

title: Madras High Court refuses to reject election petition challenging CM Vijay’s victory from Perambur
points: Madras High Court refused to dismiss the election petition against Chief Minister Vijay.
The petition challenging his victory from Perambur was filed by voter S. Dinesh.
Justice V. Lakshminarayanan dismissed the rejection application filed by the Chief Minister.

title: Apply for Andhra Pradesh SI and police constable posts by December 16
points: Andhra Pradesh police constable and SI post applications are open until December 16.
The constable preliminary test is scheduled for January 31.
The SI test will be conducted on February 28, 2027.

title: 200-year-old Taj Mahal marble slab to be auctioned in U.K.
points: A 200-year-old Taj Mahal marble slab is set to be auctioned in the U.K.
The rectangular slab is estimated to fetch between 20,000 and 30,000 pounds.
This equals approximately ₹24 to ₹36 lakh.

title: Donald Trump urges Vladimir Putin to end ‘military aggression’ in Europe
points: Donald Trump urged Vladimir Putin to end military aggression in Europe.
The request was made during their meeting in China.
Trump believes it will help lead to a deal ending the war in Ukraine.

title: Bangladesh’s Opposition party blasts Australian media reports over leader’s visit
points: Bangladesh opposition party criticized Australian media reports concerning a leader's visit.
A legal notice was sent to The Australian newspaper citing seven defamatory imputations.
The party demanded corrections, a retraction, an apology, and document preservation.

title: AirAsia delays staff salary payments to end of month, internal email shows
points: AirAsia delayed staff salary payments to the end of the month via an internal email.
Salaries for a five-month period will be paid on the 30th of each month.
For February, the payment will be made on the last day of the month.

title: Major storm batters U.S. on Thanksgiving holiday; 400 flights cancelled
points: A major storm hit the U.S. during the Thanksgiving holiday, causing 400 flight cancellations.
New York’s Macy’s parade was postponed for the first time.
The parade has a 100-year history of uninterrupted events.

title: The fiscal cost of cash-transfer schemes
points: Cash-transfer schemes are often implemented without ex ante appraisal due to expected electoral gains.
Subsidies and cash transfers are perpetual and politically difficult to reverse.
Experts emphasize that continuous financial commitment requires prior evaluation and real-time monitoring.

title: Experts say new U.S. tariffs do not pose substantial threat, India should not rush into trade deal
points: Experts state that new U.S. tariffs do not pose a substantial threat to India.
India has been advised not to rush into a trade deal.
The USTR proposal resets the tariff framework to pre-negotiation levels.

title: Broad-based pressure on food prices continues: RBI Bulletin
points: RBI Bulletin reports broad-based pressure on food prices in the economy.
CPI inflation peaked at 6.1% in October 2026, rising from 5.5% in September.
Inflation crossed the upper tolerance level of 6% for the first time since October 2024.

title: Net FDI fell to more than 5.5-year low in September 2026, as outflows jumped 40%
points: Net Foreign Direct Investment (FDI) fell to a 5.5-year low in September 2026.
The drop occurred as capital outflows jumped by 40%.
Despite this, first-half financial year net FDI was 20% higher than the previous year.

title: Duty-free raw sugar imports up to 10 lakh tonnes allowed till March 2027
points: Duty-free raw sugar imports of up to 10 lakh tonnes are allowed until March 2027.
The move aims to ensure adequate sugar supply in the domestic market.
Imports are expected to increase during the ongoing sugar season.

title: Parenting in an anxious age: What does ‘good enough’ look like?
points: Experts suggest a radical rethink of parenting in 2027 due to global tensions and digital overload.
The focus is shifting from perfection to greater parental presence.
The approach addresses the challenges of raising children in an anxious age.

title: WhatsApp to let users buy travel eSIMs in app; Jio, Verizon among partners
points: WhatsApp is introducing a feature to let users buy travel eSIMs directly within the app.
Jio and Verizon are among the key partners for this initiative.
WhatsApp Head Kunal Shah announced this as an early exploration into eSIMs.

title: Sugar restriction during first 1000 days of life reduces cancer incidence, pace of ageing: study
points: A study reveals that restricting sugar during the first 1000 days of life reduces cancer risk.
Early sugar restriction also slows down the aging process over five decades.
Unexposed individuals maintained healthier diets and longer leukocyte telomeres on chromosomes.

title: Motorola pivots to premiumisation, aims for third spot in India
points: Motorola is shifting its focus to premiumisation to capture the third spot in India's smartphone market.
IDC report shows Motorola is currently the fifth-largest brand in India.
The company captured an 8.8% market share in the third quarter.

title: Prototype of Chandrayaan-5/LUPEX rover unveiled
points: A prototype of the Chandrayaan-5/LUPEX lunar rover was unveiled.
The unveiling took place in Japan by the Japanese space agency JAXA on November 25.
This is the fifth mission in the Chandrayaan series.

title: Tamil Nadu’s SMAT campaign exposes reluctance to move beyond familiar personnel and approaches
points: Tamil Nadu’s SMAT cricket campaign exposed a reluctance to move beyond familiar personnel.
The tournament's most successful team suffered its fifth successive group-stage exit.
They won three out of seven matches to finish sixth in Group B.

title: Telangana’s traditional martial art ‘Karra samu’ to take centre stage at Khelo India; CM Revanth keen to give it a push
points: Telangana’s traditional stick-fighting art 'Karra samu' will be featured at Khelo India.
Chief Minister Revanth Reddy is keen to give national-level push to the martial art.
Demonstrations will be held at Hakimpet Sports School.

title: IND vs NZ second Test: Blundell, Phillips take New Zealand to 246 after Akash Deep’s spirited spell
points: In the IND vs NZ second Test, New Zealand scored 246 runs following Akash Deep’s spell.
Bowler Akash Deep delivered a spirited bowling spell for India.
India picked three wickets for just 54 runs in 24 overs during the second session.

title: Sandpapergate: Cricket Australia forum will not determine responsibility for ball tampering
points: Cricket Australia announced an independent forum regarding the 2018 Sandpapergate scandal.
The forum allows players and staff to give accounts without fear of sanction.
The initiative was announced by CA on November 18.

title: World chess championship: Sindarov admits Gukesh out-prepared him in third game
points: At the World Chess Championship, Sindarov admitted Gukesh out-prepared him in the third game.
Scores were tied at 1.5-1.5 after three consecutive draws.
Gukesh played with the Black pieces in Game 3 and caught Sindarov off guard.

title: India's Defence Strength Powering National Security through Self-Reliance - www.pib.gov.in
points: India's defence strength focuses on national security through self-reliance (Atmanirbharta).
The updates are officially published via the Press Information Bureau (PIB).
Defence manufacturing and indigenization are key pillars of this policy.

title: MH–60R Romeo Delivery Completed: A Boost to India's Naval Warfare Capability - SP's Naval Forces
points: Delivery of MH-60R Romeo helicopters has been completed for the Indian Navy.
These helicopters significantly boost India's naval warfare capabilities.
The acquisition enhances anti-submarine warfare and maritime surveillance.

title: IAF showcases aerial prowess at Pune’s Lohegaon Air Force Station - News On AIR
points: The Indian Air Force showcased its aerial prowess at Lohegaon Air Force Station in Pune.
Demonstrations highlighted operational readiness and tactical capabilities.
Lohegaon serves as a key strategic base for IAF fighter aircraft.

title: Uttarakhand High Court rejects ex-Army employee’s blank-paper discharge claim - The Indian Express
points: Uttarakhand High Court rejected an ex-Army employee’s claim regarding a blank-paper discharge.
The petitioner challenged service termination procedures used by the military.
The court upheld the validity of the official discharge records.

title: Indian Army’s Four Microlight Aircraft Land and Take Off on Gujarat Highway in Historic Exercise - SSBCrack
points: The Indian Army successfully landed and took off four microlight aircraft on a Gujarat highway.
This marked a historic operational exercise for the armed forces.
The drill demonstrates emergency landing capabilities on national highways.
